Frontend: everything requested was checked end to end in Playwright (admin offer dialog with comma inputs and preview 1.085,00 € · 1.102,50 €; customer offers panel accept/decline with toast/status/buttons disappearing; expired shows 'Abgelaufen'; admin banner + badges + NEU, Details calls /offer/seen, banner count drops after reload; audit labels in German with no [object Object]; Rabobank product details show chart heading, last update, insufficient-data message, terms hint, legal issuer; with 3 stored points the chart draws an SVG line; admin catalog '6,5 %', '108,75 %', amber 'Verifizierung ausstehend', edit modal fields legal_issuer_status/terms_status/verification_note). Accepting books nothing: cash, positions, executions and executed counts are unchanged. Found 1 medium logic issue and several minor ones (below).

minor.issue: Admin can overwrite an offer that the customer already accepted or declined. Re-offering on an accepted request returned 200 and set offer.status back to 'offered', so the customer's acceptance is silently lost: no 409, no confirmation, and the audit only shows offer_created. Confirmed via API and in the customer UI (the accept/decline buttons reappeared).
valid_until in the past is accepted, so an offer can be created already expired. The customer sees 'Abgelaufen' immediately. Consider a 400 for valid_until < today.
The nav badge for Anleihen-Anfragen adds pending_bond_requests and bond_offer_responses. A pending request with an unseen response is counted twice (2 requests showed badge 4).

ui_bugs.issue: Restlaufzeit uses y.toFixed(1), which shows '0.1 J.' with a dot instead of German '0,1 J.' (seen on the ENGIE 23/26 card). This breaks the German-format requirement for non-perpetual bonds.
The floating support chat button overlaps the 'Angebot annehmen' button in the Individuelle Angebote card.

issues: bond-offer-responses-banner uses emerald classes but renders light blue/lavender in the admin theme, so it is not visibly 'green'
Audit line shows the raw key 'offer_status: offered → accepted' (the action label itself is German)
Native <input type=date> (browser picker, shows mm/dd/yyyy in en locale) instead of the shadcn Calendar
Edit modal prefills numbers with a dot (Kupon '6.5', Kurs '108.75'), not German comma (comma input is accepted)
German thousands input like '1.000,50' becomes NaN: n() only replaces the comma
Gültig bis is not zero-padded ('30.6.2027', '1.11.2026'); DD.MM.YYYY is preferred
Chart 'Letzte Kursaktualisierung: 05.11.26, 09:30' uses a 2-digit year, while the card meta uses '5.11.2026, 09:30:53' (inconsistent)
Chart Y-axis ticks like '109,005 / 108,745' come from domain auto-padding; consider rounded ticks
Request table status stays 'AUSSTEHEND' after the customer declines the offer (no hint in the table row)
